name: prompt-cache-control
description: Prompt-cache meter above the Claude Code prompt: how many tokens each request read from, wrote to and sent past the cache, a live countdown to the cache's expiry, and what to do about it (keep going, compact or clear). The TTL follows Claude Code's own rules for your account (1 hour on a Claude subscription, 5 minutes on an API key, cloud provider or usage credits, plus the TTL variables and setting) and corrects itself from request timing. /cache opens a per-turn table. A clear cache button first opens a one-line message field and runs nothing until you press Enter there; then the model writes a detailed handoff brief, /clear runs and the brief goes to the fresh conversation as its first message. With the field left empty the fresh conversation sums up where things stand and waits for your go-ahead; with a message, which goes at the end of the brief, it acts on that message at once.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: How long the cache lives after a request: auto follows Claude Code's own rules (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, the promptCacheTtl setting, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H, then 1 hour on a Claude subscription and 5 minutes on an API key, cloud provider or usage credits) and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it

warnSeconds.title: Warn before expiry (s)
warnSeconds.description: Seconds left on the countdown at which the band turns yellow and a toast reminds you the cache is about to lapse

compactAtTokens.title: Large context (tokens)
compactAtTokens.description: From this prompt size up, an expired cache suggests /compact (or /clear) before you pay to write the whole prefix again

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show the meter as a row above the prompt

status.title: Status line entry
status.description: Also pin a short entry (hit rate and countdown) under the prompt

toast.title: Toast near expiry
toast.description: Toasts as the cache lapses: at the warning threshold, then at 10, 3, 2 and 1 seconds, once per cache entry each (only for prompts of 20k tokens or more)

clearButton.title: Clear cache button
clearButton.description: A clear cache button in the band and the /cache pane: it has the model write a detailed handoff brief of the conversation, runs /clear, and sends the brief as the first message of the fresh conversation, which sums up where things stand and waits for your go-ahead. With Message before clear cache on, a press first opens a one-line field for an optional message and the handoff starts only on Enter there; a message goes at the end of the brief and the fresh conversation acts on it at once. Nothing is cleared if the brief fails

clearMessage.title: Message before clear cache
clearMessage.description: When on, clear cache first opens a message field and starts only on Enter (an empty Enter is a plain clear); when off, clear cache starts at once as before, with no field
